scenario.title: LINE／WhatsApp 上約時間
scenario.context: 約朋友的訊息往往很短，但藏了很多「未來式」：已經排好的行程、剛剛才決定的事、還不確定的計畫。英文有三種講未來的方法，用對了，對方就知道你有多確定。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Anyone down for hot pot on Saturday?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I'm down! What time are you thinking?

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Maybe 7? I'm going to book that place near Zhongxiao Dunhua.
lines.zh: 七點？我打算訂忠孝敦化附近那間。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I'm meeting a client at 5, but I'll come after that.
lines.zh: 我五點要見客戶，但結束後會過去。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: He said maybe, so he'll probably flake.
lines.zh: 他說可能，所以他八成會放鳥。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: OK, I'll book a table for four just in case.
lines.zh: 好，保險起見我訂四人桌。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hey, are we still on for tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: So sorry, I have to bail. My boss just asked me to go to Taichung tomorrow.
lines.zh: 超抱歉，我得取消。我老闆剛叫我明天去台中。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No worries! Are you going to be back by the weekend?
lines.zh: 沒關係！你週末前會回來嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Want to do Sunday brunch instead?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sounds good, but let's play it by ear. I might be exhausted.
lines.zh: 好啊，不過到時候再看，我可能會累癱。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Totally fair. I'll text you Saturday.
lines.zh: 完全可以理解。我週六再傳訊息給你。

patterns.en: Are we still on for tomorrow?
Something came up. Can we reschedule?
patterns.zh: 臨時有事，可以改時間嗎？

patterns.en: I'll text you when I get there.

chinglish.wrong: Tomorrow I will go to Taichung for business.
chinglish.right: I'm going to Taichung tomorrow for work.
chinglish.why: 已經安排好的行程用現在進行式最自然。will 聽起來像是現在才決定的。另外 for business 偏正式，口語說 for work。
Do you have time? 不算錯，但聽起來像要找你談一件事。約吃飯、出去玩說 Are you free? 比較輕鬆。

chinglish.wrong: I will go to the gym later maybe.
chinglish.right: I might go to the gym later.
chinglish.why: 不確定的事用 might，比 will…maybe 簡潔自然。

chinglish.right: Let's see how it goes. / Let's play it by ear.
chinglish.why: 「看情況」直翻的 see the situation 很生硬。

grammar.title: 未來：will / be going to / 現在進行式
grammar.oneLiner: 已經排定的行程用進行式，已經打算好的用 be going to，當下才決定或預測用 will。
whenToUse: 現在進行式：已經安排好、有時間地點的行程。I'm meeting a client at 5. / I'm flying to Tokyo on Friday.
be going to：之前就打算好的計畫，或根據眼前證據的預測。I'm going to book that place. / Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
will：說話當下才做的決定、答應、提議。OK, I'll book a table. / I'll text you later.
will 也用在一般預測：He'll probably be late.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文講未來就加「會」或「要」，「我明天要去台中」「我等下會傳訊息給你」，一個字包辦全部。所以台灣人習慣所有未來都用 will。但對母語者來說，I will go to Taichung tomorrow 聽起來像是「好吧，那我就去台中」的當下決定，而不是已經排好的出差。

examples.correct: I'm having dinner with my parents tonight.
examples.incorrect: I will have dinner with my parents tonight.
examples.note: 已經約好的事用進行式。

examples.correct: A: The printer's out of paper. B: I'll get some.
examples.incorrect: A: The printer's out of paper. B: I'm going to get some.

examples.correct: I'm going to learn to swim this summer.
Look at the sky. It's going to pour.
examples.note: 有眼前證據的預測用 going to。

examples.correct: I might be a little late.
examples.incorrect: I will maybe be a little late.

quiz.question: Sorry, I can't make it on Friday. I ___ my cousin at the airport.
quiz.explanation: 已經排定的行程用現在進行式。

quiz.question: A: It's cold in here. B: Oh, I ___ close the window.
quiz.explanation: 當下才決定要做的事用 will。

quiz.question: I'm not sure yet, but I ___ come a bit late.
Look at those dark clouds. It ___ rain.
quiz.explanation: 根據眼前證據的預測用 be going to。

quiz.question: I've already decided. I'm ___ to quit my job next year.
quiz.explanation: 已經決定好的計畫用 be going to。

slang.meaning: 想參加、有興趣（I'm down = 我要／好啊）
slang.usage: 回應邀約表示想參加。Are you down for karaoke? → I'm down!

risk.note: 朋友之間很普遍，對主管邀約不要回 I'm down，說 Sounds great。

examples.en: A: Want to go to Yangmingshan this weekend? B: I'm down.
examples.zh: A：這週末要去陽明山嗎？ B：好啊。

slang.meaning: 放鳥、臨時爽約（動詞）；常爽約的人（名詞）
slang.usage: 動詞 flake (on someone)；名詞 He's such a flake. 形容詞 flaky。

risk.note: 說某人是 flake 是在批評他不可靠，當面說會傷感情。

examples.en: Don't flake on me this time!
He's a bit flaky, so don't count on him.
examples.zh: 他有點不可靠，別指望他。

slang.usage: I have to bail = 我得取消／我得先走了。bail on someone = 放某人鴿子。

risk.note: 說自己 I have to bail 是誠實告知，語氣不重；說別人 bailed on me 則帶抱怨。

examples.en: Sorry guys, I have to bail early tonight.
examples.zh: 抱歉各位，我今晚得先走。

examples.en: She bailed on us at the last minute.
examples.zh: 她最後一刻放我們鴿子。

slang.usage: 不先定死計畫，看當天狀況決定。

risk.note: 工作上也能用，例如 Let's play it by ear and see how the client reacts.

examples.en: I don't know how long the meeting will take, so let's play it by ear.
examples.zh: 不知道會議要開多久，到時候再看。

examples.en: We didn't plan anything. We're just going to play it by ear.
examples.zh: 我們沒排行程，打算隨興。

review.question: Which is correct?
review.explanation: 複習第 8 單元：have a + 症狀名詞。

review.question: ___ supposed to rain this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
review.explanation: 複習第 7 單元：天氣用 It。

review.question: We don't have ___ milk left.
review.explanation: 複習第 5 單元：否定句用 any；milk 不可數，不能用 many。

review.question: A: What ___ you do? B: I'm an illustrator.
review.explanation: 複習第 1 單元：問職業用 What do you do?

review.question: A: Anyone ___ for karaoke tonight? B: Me!
